comparison.baseline: SD1.4 Euler50 CFG7.5 PAG0.3 SG-prev scale 0
comparison.method: SD1.4 Euler50 CFG7.5 PAG0.3 SG-prev scale 3

decision_rule.green: delta <= -0.25, at least 3/4 fixed blocks negative, and paired 80% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0
decision_rule.paper_comparison_boundary: local 1k absolute FID is never compared directly with paper 5k/30k/50k FID
decision_rule.red: delta >= 0 or at most 2/4 fixed blocks negative
decision_rule.yellow: delta < 0 and at least 3/4 blocks negative, but magnitude < 0.25 or the 80% CI crosses 0; rerun one untouched fresh 1k

selection_rule: take the 1000 lexicographically smallest SHA256(salt\0source_index\0prompt), then emit in source-index order
